expert_m.name: Old Man
dialog: Have you seen the little shrine in the middle of town? It was standing long before the town was.
Nobody remembers who built it. We just keep it swept and look after it.

ninja_boy.name: Boy
dialog: Psst! Don't look at me. I'm keeping watch on this house in secret.

ace_trainer_f.name: Trainer
dialog: I climbed all the way up the mountain to see the old ruins here.
The air is so still and clear. You can almost hear the past whispering.

signs.map_signpost:
Celestic Town
Where the mountains keep the stories of long ago.
